name: Sources & Uses
summary: LBO / acquisition-financing Sources & Uses: two balancing pitchbook tables with % of total, x EBITDA, mix bars and footnotes; capitalization mode for a pro forma capital structure with cumulative leverage.
summary_zh: 杠杆收购 / 收购融资的资金来源与运用表：左右两张必须平衡的投行表格，含占比、EBITDA 倍数、构成条和脚注；capitalization 模式展示交割后资本结构与累计杠杆倍数。
description_zh: 交易融资页的标准表格：每行数据是一项资金来源（定期贷款、债券、现有现金、展期股权、发起人股权）或资金运用（收购股权、再融资、交易费用、融资费用、留存现金），side 字段区分左右两栏。每栏显示金额（货币符号只出现在首行和合计行，符合投行排版）、占本栏合计的百分比和 EBITDA 倍数（取自字段，或由 options.ebitda 计算），表头下方的迷你堆积条用序数色阶展示构成，行前色块即为图例；两栏合计行对齐在同一水平线上，若来源与运用不相等会显示红色“Out of balance”提示。notes 字段自动编号为脚注列在表格下方。mode: 'capitalization' 时读取 capital_structure（instrument / amount / rate / maturity / multiple_cum），显示利率、到期日、累计杠杆倍数与小计行，并以“杠杆阶梯”条标出各档债务的累计倍数。适合 LBO、收购融资和再融资方案页。
best_for: Pro forma capitalisation with cumulative leverage (mode: capitalization)
avoid_when: More than ~10 items per side (summarise into fewer lines)
Time series of debt (use debt maturity bars or a waterfall)

item.desc: Line item / instrument (falls back to an 'instrument' field); cross-filter field

amount.desc: Amount (its format drives the amount column)

multiple.desc: x EBITDA per line (total = total amount / implied EBITDA); capitalization falls back to a 'multiple_cum' field, shown as is when its name contains 'cum', otherwise as a running sum. options.ebitda computes the multiples instead

pct.desc: % of total as stored; when unmapped it is computed from the amounts so each side sums to 100%

notes.desc: Row footnote text (numbered (1), (2) ... and listed under the tables; identical notes share a number)

mode.desc: sources-uses (two balancing panels) | capitalization (one pro forma capital-structure table with cumulative leverage)

sides.desc: Side values in panel order, left to right (case-insensitive); other values follow

titles.desc: {item, amount, pct, multiple, rate, maturity} column header overrides (amount defaults to the field unit, e.g. 'USD m')

columns.desc: Numeric columns to show (capitalization adds rate and maturity when the fields exist)

format.desc: Amount format (defaults to the amount field format)

pctFormat.desc: % format (defaults to the pct field format, else 0.0%)

multipleFormat.desc: Multiple format (defaults to the multiple field format, else 0.0x)

ebitda.desc: EBITDA for x EBITDA = amount / ebitda; overrides the multiple field (e.g. to switch to an LTM basis — retitle with titles.multiple). Without it the EBITDA is implied from the multiple column (sum of amounts / sum of multiples), so balanced sides show the same total multiple; capitalization totals use the cumulative value

currency.desc: first: currency symbol on the first row and the totals only (pitchbook style) | all

mixBar.desc: Mini stacked bar of the mix under each header (ordinal ramp; row swatches are its key); capitalization: leverage ladder with cumulative multiples

alignTotals.desc: Pad the shorter side so both total rows sit on the same line (dropped when the panels stack on narrow screens)

tolerance.desc: Sources and uses differing by more than this (amount units) show the red out-of-balance chip

highlight.desc: Item(s) drawn in accent2 (bar segment, swatch, row tint), e.g. 'Sponsor equity'

subtotals.desc: Capitalization: [{after: '<item>', label: 'Total debt'}] cumulative subtotal rows

footnotes.desc: Extra footnotes appended after the row notes

crossFilter.desc: Click a row to cross-filter on the item field (other rows dim). Off by default: filtering a balancing table rarely makes sense

crossFilterScope.desc: dataset: the selection only filters blocks bound to the same dataset | global

interactions: Hover a row or bar segment to link them (tooltip on segments)
Optional click-to-cross-filter on rows (crossFilter: true; others dim)
Bars grow on reveal and glide when filters change
Out-of-balance warning chip when totals differ
